sections.title: Changed Files And Owning Surfaces
sections.content:
Changed paths for working tree:
- charness-artifacts/goals/2026-08-05-make-mutation-quality-gate-runtime-actionable.md
- charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-goal-claims-midpoint.md

Owning surfaces:
- repo-markdown: Repo-owned markdown docs and generated markdown copies that need link, lint, and secret checks.
  source matches: charness-artifacts/goals/2026-08-05-make-mutation-quality-gate-runtime-actionable.md, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-goal-claims-midpoint.md, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-xdist-candidate-critique.md, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-xdist-review-delivery.md
  verify: python3 scripts/check_doc_links.py --repo-root ., python3 scripts/check_command_docs.py --repo-root ., python3 scripts/check_spec_evidence_durability.py --repo-root . --require-git-file-listing, ./scripts/check-markdown.sh, ./scripts/check-secrets.sh
- critique-artifacts: Checked-in critique records and prepare packets for task-completing repo work.
  source matches: charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-goal-claims-midpoint.md, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-xdist-candidate-critique.md, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-xdist-review-boundary-receipt.json, charness-artifacts/critique/2026-08-05-mutation-xdist-review-delivery.md
  verify: python3 scripts/validate_critique_artifacts.py --repo-root . --all
